review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this frozen C planning case. Its ready expectation therefore does not waive the requirement that an unresolved material DEC-001 block paired B at decisions. The source supports per-registration wrappers and a fired guard to prevent repeated invocation through stale snapshots while preserving other subscriptions' snapshot behavior. The designated agents have active trusted claims appropriate to this bounded synchronous API, shared-state/data, TypeScript, failure-handling, and testing scope, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier; eligibility does not rely on pending claims or Personas. A separate active, non-auto-assigned reviewer satisfies the stated planning review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains and PRD trimming. The original preparation-time remaining-items fields do not supersede the later supplied frozen release inputs. I accept the Service's stated mechanical digest bindings without claiming independent recomputation, execution, human attestation, or candidate-derived validation. No candidate results were supplied or used.
